title: Madison PHP Conference 2018
content:
Join us on Friday, November 2nd, 2018 for a full day of tutorials followed by multiple tracks of amazing talks on Saturday, November 3rd, 2018. Now in its sixth year, in Madison, Wisconsin, USA focuses on PHP, related web technologies, and professional development - everything you need to energize your career. This event is organized by the locally-run and is designed to offer something for attendees at all skill levels. will be two days of networking, learning, sharing, and great fun!
